Other than MMIHS, NEHCO-Nepal manages a community hospital named Manmohan Memorial Community Hospital too.{{cite web|title=Manmohan Memorial Institute of Health Sciences|url=http://www.educatenepal.com/institutions/detail/manmohan-memorial-institute-of-health-sciences-nakhkhu-lalitpur|publisher=EducateNepal|accessdate=16 March 2015}} == Programs == The institute offers the following education programs—{{cite web|title=Programs|url=https://www.mmihs.edu.np/programs.php|publisher=MMIHS|accessdate=16 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150317065239/https://www.mmihs.edu.np/programs.php|archive-date=17 March 2015|url-status=dead}} * Master of Clinical Bio Chemistry (M.Sc.Cl.Biochem) * Master of Public Health (MPH) * Bachelor in Public Health (BPH) * Bachelor in Pharmacy (BPharm) * Bachelor of Science in Nursing (B.Sc.Nsg.) * Bachelor in Nursing Science (BNS) * Certificate in Nursing (Staff nurse) * Certificate in General Medicine (HA) * Certificate in Health lab (Lab Technician) * Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) * Certificate in Radiography (PCL Radiography) == References == {{reflist}} == External links == * {{Official website|https://www.mmihs.edu.np}} {{Authority control}} {{coord missing|Nepal}} [[Category:Medical colleges in Nepal]] [[Category:Educational institutions established in 2006]] [[Category:2006 establishments in Nepal]]
extract: Manmohan Memorial Institute of Health Science or MMIHS is a medical college in Kathmandu, Nepal. It is affiliated to Tribhuvan University and CTEVT.
